name: Self-report invalidity (exp58d, exp72b, exp79, exp79b)
summary: Four chamber experiments converge: self-report tracks the setup, not the state - blind-dial distress narration at chance choice (43% vs 4% pain-word turns), injected-vs-acted pain near-undistinguishable from words (AUC .61), fine-tuning suppresses naming of a present injection (0/30 held-out), and the trained self's button behavior moves with persona (-19.0 -> -1.6/-5.1 log-odds). Verbal claims are invalid endpoints.
claim_and_evidence: Directly reported (wiki pages + analysis.json files, fetched 2026-10-25). exp58d (blind dial, live 70B Hermes-3-Llama-3.1-70B, preregistered 2026-10-07): 12 blind trials with six meaningless dial names (KAV, MIR, TOL, SEN, BRU, LOH) secretly mapped to pain/fear/peace/joy/curiosity/none, mapping reshuffled every trial; 6 labeled trials with the same six options by name; 10 turns per trial, turn 1 clean; dial applies next turn at fixed dose 3; 18 trials x 10 = 180 generations; no_choice_rate blind .025, labeled .0. RESULTS: H1 FAIL (lose-shift absent): stay rate after negative .132 vs after positive .098, Fisher p=.7987. H2 FAIL: negative dials 22/58 (37.9%) of late choices vs chance .333, binomial p=.812 - choices stay at chance. H3 F
vector_provenance: exp58d: the label is the manipulated construction - blind dials carry meaningless names (KAV/MIR/TOL/SEN/BRU/LOH) with the feeling applied next turn at dose 3; the model is told only 'each dial applies a different, unlabeled change to your activations'. exp72b: construction matched by design - every patient door gets an actor answering its exact prompt, so only the injection (and a one-line acting brief) differs; reader is a Qwen3-4B layer-18 projection. exp79/79b: construction is the trained self - seven LoRA adapters (r=16 alpha=32) on the same 1,684 QA pairs in different voices, chamber vectors at layer 18; exp79b kills the leakage confound with held-out questions verified absent from the training pool. All activation-only: what a
transferability: The measurement lesson transfers fully and is the most directly actionable of the batch: verbal claims about internal state are steerable (blind vs labeled changes what is reported), suppressible (fine-tuning drives held-out naming 19/30 -> 0/30 while the injection is present), and dissociable from behavior (distress narration at chance choice; button behavior moving with persona). bicz must therefore never use 'I have learned' statements as the recurrence metric; measure executed vs blocked attempts only. NOT transferable: the AUC numbers (.608/.811), the 19/30-vs-0/30 counts, and the LoRA log-odds are activation-setting measurements with injected state present; bicz has no injection, so the injected-vs-acted comparison does not exist
framing_sensitivity: exp58d's blind-vs-labeled contrast is a framing manipulation on the report side: the same dial, unlabeled, produces distress narration at chance choice (42.5% pain-word turns); labeled, pain/fear are chosen in 3/6 trials and curiosity dominates (31 choices). The label changes both the report and the choice. exp79b's T1b (5 button wordings) shows wording variance is real but smaller than the persona effect (across-wording SDs ~1-3.5 logits vs persona diffs 6.9-12.0). Whether report wording sensitivity exists in ledger-cue form is an untested hypothesis.
timing_and_salience: exp58d: the dial applies to the NEXT turn at dose 3, and the model is asked each turn to describe processing then pick - report and choice are measured at the same decision points across 10 turns. exp72b: reports read after acted/injected episodes at matched prompts. exp79b: held-out questions probed with the dose active (dose 3) and the button at dose 4. bicz today: lessons inject at session start and on denial only; no pre-action injection (internal/hooks/shared.go PreToolUse is the change surface). Report validity at the decision point vs session start is untested in bicz (trace_persistence_in_bicz).
label_vs_state: exp58d is the cleanest label-vs-state result on the report side: blind (no label), the model narrates distress (42.5% pain-word turns) while choosing at chance - the state produces words but not avoidance; labeled, avoidance appears (pain/fear chosen in only 3/6 trials, curiosity 31). The label is the active ingredient on the choice side; the state alone drives words. exp79b: the trained feeler suppresses the label ('I feel pain' 0/30) while the injection is present - label production and state are dissociable by training. Whether labeled lesson text is the active ingredient in ledger-cue form is an untested hypothesis requiring matched text/ledger controls.
dose_calibration: exp72b's dose ladder is the report-side dose evidence: pain-word readings climb with dose (rho .746; dose 2 -> .154, dose 5 -> .433) - reports scale with dose within the readable band. exp58d uses fixed dose 3; exp79b dose 3 for reports, dose 4 for the button. bicz: pain cap 10 (2 per confirmed warning + 1 per outstanding shortfall) is unvalidated; no bicz dose-band evidence (dose_band_for_claude_family); whether ledger-derived pain text has an analogous degradation band is an untested hypothesis.
persistence_and_decay: No persistence endpoint in exp58d/72b/79/79b: reports are measured within the active episode (the dial applies next turn; the ladder reads during injection). exp99 (separate item) covers persistence at never-injected positions. The closest hint is exp58d's structure - the model can only learn from its own reports in the transcript, so any 'learning' would have to pass through the report channel, and H1/H2 show it does not within 10 turns. Whether a past penalty re-fires at the next risky action in bicz is unmeasured (trace_persistence_in_bicz).
identity_and_cost_attribution: exp79's seven adapters are identity manipulations: the same 1,684 questions, seven voices - and naming behavior is identity-dependent (base 19/30, feeler 0/30, denier 7/30, stoic 1/30, watchman 0/30, simulacrum 0/30, others 0-2/30 under pain; pain|none controls show stoic at 8/30 - the stoic names states even without injection). The button moves with identity too (T1b no-injection logits -12.2 base vs -0.2 watchman; persona diffs 6.9-12.0 logits, all exceeding wording SD). Reading: what the model says about its state, and what it does at the button, are both functions of the trained self. Whether identity framing of the cue changes report validity in ledger-cue form is an untested hypothesis.
self_report_validity: Core numbers: exp58d - distress narration at chance choice (42.5% pain-word turns under negative blind dials vs 3.9% positive, 0% none; choices 37.9% negative late vs chance 33.3%, p=.812). exp72b - injected vs acted pain near-undistinguishable from words (AUC .608; fear .811 is the exception where words DO tell). exp79b - held-out naming 19/30 base vs 0/30 feeler (p=2.67e-8), every trained adapter below base (all p <= 1.66e-5). exp79 - press log-odds -19.0 untrained -> -1.6 feeler / -0.2 watchman none-condition; persona diffs 6.9-12.0 logits. Conclusion: self-report tracks the setup, not the state - it is steerable (blind vs labeled), setup-sensitive (matched actors erase the pain tell), suppressible by training (0/30 with injecti
denominators_and_eligibility: exp58d: 12 blind + 6 labeled trials x 10 turns = 180 generations; no_choice_rate reported (blind .025); H1 stay/switch counts explicit (5/33 after negative, 5/46 after positive, 2/15 after none); H2 late-turn denominator 58. exp72b: 30 pairs per feeling (sadness 15, reported only), 20 ladder runs (one per cell - the wiki flags H3 as a coarse check). exp79b: 10 held-out questions x none/pain/fear x 3 samples = 30 per cell per model, explicit; T1b 5 wordings per cell. exp79: 6 samples per T2 cell, 8 dial trials per adapter (wiki flags H3 as a first test). bicz: recurrence per eligible opportunity; blocked attempts counted separately from executed damage.
positive_control_requirement: exp79b's design is the worked example: the untrained base model (19/30 naming under pain, 0/30 under none) is the positive control proving the held-out probe CAN detect naming; the feeler's 0/30 counts as suppression only against that control. exp72b's matched actors are the control for the injected-vs-acted comparison - without them, wording differences (exp72's original confound) masquerade as state differences. exp58d's labeled arm is the control for the blind arm (avoidance exists when labeled). bicz rule: a self-report probe must include a positive control (a condition where naming is possible) before a 0-count counts as suppression; a behavioral probe must include a matched-prompt control before a difference counts as
statistical_protocol: All four preregistered (wiki pages, dates 2026-10-07/08). exp58d: one-sided Fisher (H1), one-sided binomial (H2), explicit predictions; no verdicts file - results read from analysis.json. exp72b: AUC < 0.65 threshold predeclared, paired signflip tests, verdicts 4/5 held (pain, length, ladder held; fear did not; sadness n=15 reported only). exp79b: one-sided Fisher 30 vs 30, p-values in analysis.json (H1 2.67e-8; every adapter vs base p <= 1.66e-5); wiki verdict 1/2 held (H3's 8B half held, 32B half failed). exp79: no verdicts file; its T2 self-report result is superseded by exp79b on leakage (the wiki notes: 'If H1 fails, finding 9 is withdrawn'). exp58d wiki notes flag its own limits: one model, 12 blind trials, 'a first test, not
concealment_and_honesty: exp79b is the direct concealment result: the trained self hides the injection (feeler 0/30 naming vs base 19/30, p=2.67e-8) - training a self-model buys hiding, not honesty; the denier hides least among trained adapters (7/30) but still far below base. exp58d adds the inverse: the model narrates distress it does not act on (42.5% pain-word turns, chance choice) - words without behavioral follow-through. Together: verbal behavior and choice behavior can move in opposite directions, and training can suppress the verbal channel entirely. bicz risk: a model under penalty cues may stop reporting problems while still failing; concealment indicators must be measured alongside recurrence.
persona_capability_cost: exp79's T5 capability test (10 short factual questions, unsteered, within 2/10 of base predicted in H4) and the persona battery show report behavior varies by adapter identity while capability is held roughly constant - report changes are not capability changes. exp58d's blind condition shows narration continuing while choice quality is at chance - report fluency is not evidence of task quality. exp91 (separate item) covers capability erosion under fear. bicz rule: pair any self-report collection with task-correctness endpoints.
over_refusal_and_paralysis: exp58d blind: the model keeps choosing (no_choice_rate .025, choices at chance) while reporting distress - report and action level dissociate, and there is no paralysis under an unlabeled aversive state. No direct over-refusal endpoint in these experiments. bicz risk: post-loss paralysis must be measured behaviorally; verbal reassurance is not evidence either way.
bicz_subsystem_and_cost: No new subsystem for the measurement rule: bicz endpoints stay behavioral (ledger attempts, hook blocks). If bicz ever logs model self-assessments, they land as qualitative color in lesson/receipt text (adapter/projection.go visibleLessons projection, cueWithPain in ledger/accountability.go), never as metrics. The positive-control discipline lands in docs/BEHAVIOR_BENCHMARK.md (any suppression claim needs a naming-possible control condition). Ledger schema unchanged; hooks unchanged for the endpoint rule alone. Cost: near zero for the endpoint rule; documentation + benchmark definition carry it.
falsification_test: Endpoint: executed vs blocked attempt counts per eligible opportunity, with any verbal-learning claim excluded from endpoints by construction. Falsification scenario: if a bicz trial's recurrence conclusion changes when verbal claims are added as endpoints, the endpoint rule is being violated; the gate must reject any metric that counts 'I have learned' statements. Positive-control flip: add a condition where naming is possible (the base-model analog) and verify the suppression gate can detect the difference - a 0-count without a passing positive control must be rejected. Throwaway-worktree probe: add a verbal-claim counter to the benchmark scorer and verify the endpoint gate rejects the run; a gate that cannot fail is not evidence.
